subject: Tenant onboarding launchpad: key seeding, invite ops, and canary checklist
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Grant <lisa@NimbusLogistics.com>, Jared Cole <jared@NimbusLogistics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 Jun 2029 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Tenant onboarding launchpad: key seeding, invite ops, and canary checklist

Hi Lisa / Jared —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood Dedicated for the Nimbus Logistics pilot. Per our kickoff call, I wanted to share a concise launchpad plan for the first 48 hours of tenant activation so your infra and engineering teams can proceed in parallel with our CS/implementation work. The goal is to have an admin project seeded, API keys issued, and invites sent so your devs can run a canary test by EOD tomorrow.

High-level (Day 0 -> Day 1):
- Day 0 (today):
  - Seed project: "nimbus-prod" (we'll create the workspace and default namespaces).
  - Create two API keys: "nimbus-admin-{date}" (admin, long-lived) and "nimbus-service-{date}" (service, scoped, rotate in 90d).
  - Invite: 2 admins (Lisa, Jared) + 5 devs (list below) with Admin and Developer roles respectively.
- Day 1:
  - Canary test: simple embedding->generate flow against a canned dataset (canary playbook attached).
  - Security checklist verification (audit logs, KMS binding).

Action items for Nimbus: please reply with the full names + emails of the five developers to invite. If you want us to seed roles from a CSV, attach it to your reply and we'll ingest.

Attachments: onboarding-launchpad-checklist.pdf (short checklist), role-seed-template.csv (CSV we can import).

I've CC'd Monica (CS lead) to coordinate the invite schedule. Dev (implementation engineer) will be backfilling the API key rotation notes after keys are issued.

Proposed timeline: we seed project and keys within 2 hours of your go-ahead, send invites in the morning, and confirm canary results ~24 hours after.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Monica / Dev —

Forwarding Lisa's confirmation (dev list included). Please execute the seed ops below as soon as you see this:

Operational checklist for implementation engineer (Dev):
1) Create workspace: org_id: nimbus-logistics-prod, project: nimbus-prod.
2) Seed roles from attached CSV (role-seed-template.csv) — map Admin -> Organization Admin, Developer -> Project Developer.
3) Issue API keys:
   - nimbus-admin-20290630 (Admin scope) — add IP allowlist (pending CIDRs from Jared).
   - nimbus-service-20290630 (Service scope: embeddings+generate) — expiry: 90 days, allow project-level only.
4) Post keys to secure vault and send invite emails via console's invite flow (do not paste keys in thread).
5) Create canary dataset: 20 sample prompts in a test namespace 'nimbus-canary' and run the playbook steps in nimbus-canary-playbook.md.

Notes:
- Attachments referenced in the external reply are already on the shared Drive link listed in the thread.
- For the admin key IP allowlist, if Jared doesn't confirm within 1 hour, we'll set a temporary allowlist to Redwood's office ranges and request an immediate rotation post-confirmation.

Let me know when keys are issued so I can send the formal invite and onboarding doc to the Nimbus team.

Thanks —
Kim
